bio.text: Jason Smith was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives from Missouri in 2013 and has chaired the House Ways and Means Committee since January 2023.
He served in the Missouri General Assembly from 2005 to 2013, rising to Speaker Pro Tem.
He grew up in Salem, Missouri, earned degrees in Agricultural Economics and Business Administration at the University of Missouri-Columbia, and attended law school at Oklahoma City University.
